words.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)
words.secondDef: Something like such a unit of language:
words.thirdDef: To say or write (something) using particular words; to phrase (something).
words.fourthDef: To flatter with words, to cajole.

words.definition: Great or overwhelming beauty or splendour.
words.secondDef: Honour, admiration, or distinction, accorded by common consent to a person or thing; high reputation; renown.
words.thirdDef: To exult with joy; to rejoice.

words.definition: To be on fire, especially producing bright flames.
words.secondDef: To send forth or reflect a bright light; shine like a flame.
words.thirdDef: To blow, as from a trumpet

words.definition: A star, especially when seen as the centre of any single solar system.
words.secondDef: The light and warmth which is received from the sun.
words.thirdDef: To expose to the warmth and radiation of the sun.
words.fourthDef: To warm or dry in the sunshine.

words.definition: The condition of being amazed; overwhelming wonder, as from surprise, sudden fear, horror, or admiration; astonishment.
words.secondDef: A particular feeling of wonder, surprise, fear, or horror.

words.definition: The act of repelling or the condition of being repelled.
words.secondDef: An extreme dislike of something, or hostility to something.

words.definition: To deprive by or as if by violence; to rob; to strip; to benim.
words.secondDef: To take away by destroying, impairing, or spoiling; take away by violence.
words.thirdDef: (of a person) Pained by the loss of someone.
words.fourthDef: Deprived of, lacking, stripped of, robbed of.
